subject: Clarification & next steps: Hosted inference p95 elevation affecting Novacredit
messages:
From: Jamie Lin <jamie.lin@novacredit.com>
To: Priya Natarajan <priya.natarajan@redwood.com>
Cc: Aisha Patel <aisha.patel@novacredit.com>
Date: 2025-11-08 08:12:00 -0800
Subject: Observed p95 latency increase for hosted inference (Novacredit)

Hi Priya,

We started seeing elevated p95 for our model scoring calls to your hosted API late last night (~2025-11-07 21:00 UTC). The impact is intermittent but reproducible — our user-facing flows experience noticeable delay spikes (screenshots and sample request attached). Example request IDs: req-78a4, req-78b0.

Can you confirm whether there was a deployment or a change to routing/prefetching around that time? We need an ETA for mitigation — the product team is asking whether to switch to a local fallback.

Attaching a small HAR and timing traces. Please advise.

Thanks,
Jamie Lin
Head of Integrations, Novacredit
jamie.lin@novacredit.com

Attachments: sample-har-req123.har (application/har)

Date: 2025-11-08 09:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Observed p95 latency increase for hosted inference (Novacredit)

Hi Jamie — thanks for the quick heads up and for the HAR. We’ve opened incident IR-2025-11-08-09 on our status page (link below) and I’ve looped in Ben from Platform to triage.

Short answers up front:
- We had a rolling runtime kernel tweak deployed late on 11/07 which may have affected a small subset of model variants; we’re investigating correlation.
- We’re treating this as a high-priority SLO-impact incident and will provide a remediation ETA within 1 hour.

Can you also share:
- A short curl with headers that reproduce the timing?
- Whether you’re pinned to a specific model variant (model id in the request) or using the default routed model?

We’ll update this thread and the status page. Apologies for the disruption — we’ll work to get you a mitigation plan ASAP.

Link: https://status.redwood.ai/incidents/IR-2025-11-08-09

Best,

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>

Date: 2025-11-08 11:30:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Observed p95 latency increase for hosted inference (Novacredit)

Priya / Jamie — quick tech update from infra:

Summary of findings so far:
- We observed a ~2.2x increase in p95 on requests routed to the redwood-open-13b-q4 variant starting at 2025-11-07T21:02:00Z.
- The spike correlates with a small kernel optimization that reduced on-GPU prefetch concurrency for that code path and changed scheduling for KV-cache maintenance. The net effect: higher prefix cache miss amplification and more synchronous disk reads under specific sequence-length distributions.
- Novacredit traffic pattern (bursty, many short contexts with prefetch) amplified the fanout.

Immediate mitigations applied (11:05–11:20 PST):
- We reverted the kernel change for the affected runtime flag for redwood-open-13b-q4 on the primary pool.
- Increased prefetch concurrency for the route handling Novacredit to reduce miss penalties.

Impact of mitigations: p95 reduced from ~1.6s to ~0.95s in our internal test harness for similar request shapes; we’re continuing to observe production telemetry for the next 30–45 minutes.

Next steps I recommend:
1) Keep Novacredit routed to the primary pool while we validate for 2 hours.
2) After stabilization, run a targeted canary of the kernel tweak on a small, cold pool for objective metrics.
3) Postmortem + action items (we’ll capture root cause and change gating).

Attachment: repro-trace-req123.txt (short logs showing cache miss rate jump).

—Ben
Ben Carter
Principal SRE, Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.com

Hi Jamie / team — quick status:

- Mitigation completed and rolled out to Novacredit routing at 2025-11-08T20:20:00Z (our internal clocks). Production p95 for your traffic has stabilized to ~0.9–1.0s. We’ll continue elevated sampling for 2 hours.
- Root cause preliminary: a runtime kernel optimization reduced prefetch concurrency on a specific model variant which increased prefix cache miss amplification for your traffic shape.

Immediate asks / next steps:
1) Would you be available for a 45-minute postmortem call on Mon 2025-11-10 between 14:00–17:00 UTC? We want to walk through the timeline, the change gating gap, and a short remediation plan (improved gating and a canary plan).
2) If you can share any additional slow traces from after 20:20Z it will help validate full stabilization.

We will produce a short postmortem summary and action-item list in the next 48 hours and share the draft to the Google Drive link below.

Postmortem draft link: https://drive.google.com/open?id=1A2b3Cpm-postmortem-draft
Status page: https://status.redwood.ai/incidents/IR-2025-11-08-09

Apologies for the disruption and thanks for the patience. We value the stability of your integration and will follow up with the PM and SRE action items.
